presentation.title: Hammer Jam is here — test announcement
presentation.summary: We’re testing remote news and events in Clashboard. A sample Hammer Jam is now active, with an ending countdown and a full event information page.

sections.title: Meet the test Hammer Jam
sections.body: The test runs October 6–20, 2026. It configures 50% shorter eligible Home Village upgrade durations and 50% lower wall costs, combined with Gold Pass. Supercharges, Crafted Defenses, and Builder Base upgrades are excluded.

sections.title: Open the event details
sections.body: On Home, look below Selected Profile for Hammer Jam (Test). Tap the event card for the countdown, boost explanation, Gold Pass examples, timer behavior, and exclusions.

sections.title: News without an app update
sections.body: Announcements like this can be published through the remote JSON feed. Find the archive in Help (?) → News, alongside Welcome and What’s New. Only the latest unread announcement can open automatically; What’s New takes priority on a new app build.

sections.title: Testing notice
sections.body: This is a Clashboard test, not an official Supercell announcement or an in-game boost. Use a test village when checking timers: fetching this configuration can shorten eligible timers tracked before its start. Fresh exports remain authoritative.
